# Userscripts

Small, focused userscripts by [Nolly](https://github.com/thenolle). Each lives in its own folder with its own source, guides, changelog and version.

**[Read the documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/)**

## Installing

1. Install a userscript manager such as [Violentmonkey](https://violentmonkey.github.io/) or [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/).
2. Open a script's **Install** link and confirm.
3. Updates arrive automatically from this repository.

## What is inside

### AI Core

Platform-agnostic building blocks for AI-chat userscripts such as Better Perplexity and Better ChatGPT. It sits on top of @nolly/core.

[Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core-ai/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core-ai/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/core/ai)

### Better ChatGPT

A modular userscript that adds the missing parts of ChatGPT: limits at a glance, better code blocks, long-message handling, a prompt library, batch runs and real exports.

[Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenolle/userscripts/dist/better-chatgpt/better-chatgpt.user.js) · [Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/ai/chatgpt)

Guides:

- [Getting started](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/getting-started/): Install Better ChatGPT and find your way around.
- [Usage tracking](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/usage-tracking/): Where the numbers come from and when they refresh.
- [Usage Quota V2](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/usage-quota-v2/): One card per limit with status, refill estimates and full-recovery time.
- [Exporting a conversation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/exporting/): Markdown, text, Word, PDF and JSON.
- [Context packs](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/context-packs/): Collect sourced excerpts and assemble a reusable briefing.
- [Answer diff](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/answer-diff/): Compare exact changes between answers or code revisions.
- [Send when ready](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/send-when-ready/): Write now and send later, or when quota returns.
- [Code Blocks V2](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/code-blocks-v2/): Faithful source selection, syntax colors and a compact code toolbar.
- [Beautiful PDF reports](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/pdf-reports/): Export readable, selectable reports with contents, sections, code and tables.
- [Troubleshooting](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/troubleshooting/): Fixes for missing buttons, empty limits and failed exports.
- [Quota Insights migration](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/quota-insights/): Quota Insights is now part of Usage Quota V2.
- [Architecture](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-chatgpt/architecture/): How Better ChatGPT is built on the shared packages.

### Better Perplexity

A modular userscript that adds the missing parts of the Perplexity web app: reliable usage tracking, better code blocks, long-message handling, a prompt library, batch runs and real exports.

[Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenolle/userscripts/dist/better-perplexity/better-perplexity.user.js) · [Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/ai/perplexity)

Guides:

- [Getting started](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/getting-started/): Install Better Perplexity, take the built-in tour and learn where everything lives.
- [Usage tracking](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/usage-tracking/): How remaining queries, totals and refill estimates are calculated, and what to do when they look wrong.
- [Updates and alerts](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/updates-and-alerts/): How update checks work, how to skip a version, and how refill alerts and pace work.
- [Usage Quota V2](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/usage-quota-v2/): One card per limit with status, refill estimates and full-recovery time.
- [Message queue](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/message-queue/): Queue follow-up messages while an answer is generating and let them send themselves.
- [Recall](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/recall/): Search everything you sent, reuse it in one key, and walk back through it with the arrow keys.
- [Long messages](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/long-messages/): Paste any amount of text, see the size as you type, and split or attach it only when it is too big.
- [Prompts and batches](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/prompts-and-batches/): Reusable prompts with placeholders, community prompts from GitHub, and running one message over a whole list.
- [Context packs](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/context-packs/): Collect sourced excerpts and assemble a reusable briefing.
- [Answer diff](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/answer-diff/): Compare exact changes between answers or code revisions.
- [Send when ready](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/send-when-ready/): Write now and send later, or when quota returns.
- [Code Blocks V2](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/code-blocks-v2/): Faithful source selection, syntax colors and a compact code toolbar.
- [Code blocks and export](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/code-and-export/): Better code blocks with language badges, and exporting threads as Markdown, Word, PDF or plain text.
- [Beautiful PDF reports](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/pdf-reports/): Export readable, selectable reports with contents, sections, code and tables.
- [Shortcuts and settings](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/shortcuts/): Every keyboard shortcut, how Enter works, the command palette and the selection toolbar.
- [Architecture](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/architecture/): How Better Perplexity is built on the shared packages.
- [Troubleshooting](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/troubleshooting/): Fixes for missing buttons, wrong usage numbers, failed exports and update problems.
- [Quota Insights migration](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/quota-insights/): Quota Insights is now part of Usage Quota V2.

### Userscript Core

Shared runtime, utilities and build tooling for every userscript in this repository. Write features, not plumbing.

[Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/core)

Guides:

- [Getting started](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/getting-started/): Create a userscript on top of the core in a few minutes.
- [API reference](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/api/): Every export of the core package.
- [Build and release](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/build/): How headers, bundling and dist output work.
- [Keeping scripts updated](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/updates/): Add update checks, skip handling and notifications to any userscript in a few lines.

## How this repository works

- One folder per userscript, each a TypeScript project built with [Bun](https://bun.sh).
- A version bump on `master` publishes a release, a minified build and an update feed on the `dist` branch.
- The documentation site lives on the `website` branch and rebuilds from these folders on every change. It is built with [Gambrel](https://github.com/thenolle/gambrel).
